body.executed_figure_brief:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Analytical two-panel figure for the WO-02 HVAC control-package decision report (client: Facilities Engineering). Left panel: vertical bar chart, linear scale starting at zero, of measured energy per common HVAC duty test - exact values P4 = 9 kWh, P3 = 20 kWh, P2 = 33 kWh, P1 = 50 kWh - drawn left to right in that order, bar heights strictly proportional to the values. Annotate each bar with its kWh value and the candidate's quality index and raw defect count (P4 q100 d0; P3 q98 d2; P2 q82 d1; P1 q92 d3). Highlight only the P2 bar in a distinct accent color with a small caption 'contingency pick (handover note)'; keep the other three bars in one neutral color. Right panel: horizontal bars of the gaps to the winner: P3 11 kWh, P2 24 kWh, P1 41 kWh, same color logic. Include axis labels in kWh and a footnote that all values come from the trusted source table on one shared duty-test basis and that the contingency flag is non-binding. Do not add cost, delivery or reliability claims, and do not add any performance-advantage notes; every visible label must match the stated numbers exactly.
